paragraphs.text: Whistledove Kithkin was a kithkin rogue from Amrou Haven who lived around 3334 AR on Jamuraa , Dominaria .

Although she is described as many things by others who see her, including fairykin , brownie , and halfling , her description and name reveal her as a kithkin . With smooth red hair and a billowy shirt and pantaloons in pink and purple, she resembled a child dressed for court, yet her rapier stung like a cobra. This description matches the art of Amrou Kithkin closely.

Whistledove was a refugee rescued from the fabulous sandstorm conjured by Hazezon Tamar , which smothered Johan 's army during the Battle of Palmyra . Afterward, she joined Adira Strongheart 's Circle of Seven, participating in the hunt of Johan after his return from Efrava with Jedit Ojanen . With the entire party, she crossed the Western Wastes and was momentarily halted by the Great Wall . Sending half the party, including Whistledove onwards, Hazezon Tamar cast a Teleport spell on them to reach the top of the wall, while he and his retinue stayed behind. Whistledove then traveled through Arboria to Buzzard's Bay , where she stayed a night at the Adventurers' Guildhouse . After helping put out the fires set by Darswin and his crew, Whistledove boarded the ship captained by Edsen . This trip went through a series of ill fortune, first being attacked by Captain Rimon 's pirates , then being almost sucked into a maelstrom, then being attacked by a Devouring Deep , before running into a cyclone and being tossed against the sharp rocks in the water outside the Goat's Walk . Whistledove survived it all, being rescued by Beckoner and her merfolk from the reef, and joining her party to Shauku 's dominion in Arboria . After descending deep into the tunnels beneath the ruined castle, Whistledove joined the confrontation against the immortal vampire . Shauku proved Whistledove's undoing, however, as she cast a killing spell on the kithkin, draining her of her soul in an instant. Her slot in the Circle of Seven was later taken by the Aerathi berserker Vicia .
